description: Counts only, from the latest close record, minepoa's grading list copy and POAScan's tx archive: pending answers by closes waited (birth band) with how many have a birth panel (coverage) and any seal; answers one qualified seal short of quorum (at 3 of 4); answers expiring at the next close and within 2 and 3 closes; and per close neutral_answer and neutral_grading (POAScan's replay of a proposed rule unless source is close record: answer gap over 3 h or under 20 answer txs; seal txs under 25% of the median of the last 3 normal closes) with answers, longest_gap_s, seals and baseline. Never a pending seal blob or score. Use it to see where the grading queue is stuck. From epoch E71 on, a panel is seated from grader workload frozen at the previous close, so a grade sealed later cannot change the next panel. answer_sort is read-only context from minepoa's official Answer Sort tool (https://minepoa.com/tools/answer-sort/): measurements, not verdicts, cross-author sentence families with build_id, as_of_close, the multi-author share and the top families (members, authors, shared sentence). Counts and sentence overlaps only, no scores or verdicts; cached per close. It is context only and never changes a grade, a reward or any on-chain value.
